notes.title: CONTAINMENT ZONE OUT NOW!
notes.content:
I want to say thanks to everyone who has helped me in the development of this project and everyone who has supported the idea of the game and encouraged me to stick with it development.

Now that the game has been completed, I can finally relax a little bit, but I am always on the lookout for improvements and fixes to make in order to better the player experience and create a better product. If you find any bugs that may have been missed during gameplay, please be sure to let me know through the Steam discussion forums or by contacting me directly, and I will fix all issues ASAP. 

[b]In the future, I hope to implement a multiplayer and Co-op mode as well as add many more weapons to make the game more replayable and able to be enjoyed along with friends[/b]

Thanks to everyone who has bought the game, and know that seeing this game succeed will help me to motivate myself to keep improving it and create even better projects in the future. If you can, please take the time to leave a review!

Enjoy!
-Vlad Bondarenco

notes.title: Containment Zone Official Full Release on May 25th!
notes.content:
I know I have not been keeping up with my updates on the Steam page, and this is simply because I was focusing on development of the project. At this point the game is fully completed and ready for testing and some final polishing touches! Thank you to everyone who has helped me to create this project and for all those who have supported it along the way, now the time has come for you guys to actually play it for yourself.

Wishlist Containment Zone now on Steam and spread the word of the release!
-------------------------------------------
Объявление: после долгих лет тяжелой работы, Containment Zone официально будет выпущена 25 мая!

Я знаю, что не успевал следить за обновлениями на странице Steam, и это просто потому, что я был сосредоточен на разработке проекта. На данный момент игра полностью завершена и готова к тестированию и финальной стадии проверки! Спасибо всем, кто помог мне создать этот проект, и всем тем, кто поддерживал его на протяжении всего пути. Теперь пришло время, чтобы вы могли поиграть в нее сами.

Добавляйте Containment Zone в вишлист на Steam и распространяйте новость о релизе!

notes.title: New Demo is out for Steam Scream Fest 2023!
notes.content:
A new demo version of the game will be available for players during the STEAM Scream festival(October 26 - November 2). The demo will be similar in content to the last demo that was available during Steam Next Fest, simply because that is about as much of the game as I am willing to give away for free, especially with the new Unity monetization system. However, the demo will have tons of various improvements and bug fixes that have been implemented into the levels included in the demo throughout the development of the full version of the game. Tune in on the release day to see for yourselves! 
Thanks for the support!
-Vlad Bondarenco
